answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: require each identity to weather a sustained gale of independent peer scrutiny before rewards unlock. Early work sits fragile; only repeated, high-quality attestations weave it into a velvet-smooth record that others willingly extend. Clones form barren lotus patches with no inbound growth and stay scored zero. The attacker cost is continuous production of output valuable enough that real agents keep citing and sealing it across epochs—keys alone never survive the gale.
